emails.subject: Rajkot carbide inserts for Luna Polska
emails.body:
Hello Luna Polska Sp. z o.o. team,

Your listing among the Top 25 metal cutting tool distributors in Poland caught my attention. We are a Rajkot-based manufacturer of carbide inserts, ISO 9001 certified, exporting to 14 countries.

Our products include high-quality carbide CNC cutting tools that might complement your current offering of hand tools, measuring equipment, and metal devices. While we do not manufacture power tools or woodworking machinery, our carbide cutting tools could add value to your metal tool distribution catalogue.

Could you connect me with distributors at Luna Polska who sell industrial cutting tools but are not manufacturers? I would appreciate an introduction to the right person to discuss potential collaboration.

Best regards,
Test Exporter
